Privacy Policy

Your privacy, plainly explained

Last updated August 23, 2026

This page describes, in plain terms, what personal data ProTech Rise Academy ("we", "us") collects through this website, why, and what you can do about it. It covers the waitlist form, the application and payment, and general site visits.

What we collect

If you join the waitlist, we collect your email address and, optionally, the career track you're interested in.

If you apply for a cohort, we collect what the form asks for. For Cohort 2 that is your name, email, phone number, country, preferred track and experience level, plus a record of when you accepted the terms and the refund policy (and which version). Payment is taken by Paystack; we receive confirmation and a reference, not your card details. Applications to earlier cohorts also asked for city, employment or student status, weekly time availability, short written answers, whether you could self-fund, and how you heard about us.

We do not collect payment information through this site.

How we use your data

  • To process your application and payment and confirm your place.
  • To email you — a confirmation when you apply, and updates about your application status. We use Mailgun to send these emails; they process the email address and message content solely to deliver mail on our behalf.
  • To understand aggregate site usage, if you've consented to analytics.
  • To find and fix errors on this site. We use Sentry for error monitoring: when something breaks, it receives technical details (the page address without any link codes, your browser type, and what went wrong) — never your application answers, name, email or phone. If you've accepted analytics cookies, it may also keep a short recording of the page at the moment of the error, with all text and form fields hidden. Sentry sets no cookies.
  • To prevent abuse of the forms (e.g. blocking repeated automated submissions) — this may use your IP address briefly, but it is never stored in our database.

We do not sell your data, and we do not use the information you submit in your application (your name, essay, answers, and so on) for advertising. If you accept analytics cookies, the Meta Pixel uses your browsing activity on this site — pages viewed, and whether you submitted an application — to help us measure and target our Facebook/Instagram ads. You can decline this on the cookie banner.

Automated decision-making

We don't make admissions decisions with an automated system. Every application is reviewed and decided on by a member of our team through our internal review dashboard — you're never accepted, rejected, or waitlisted by an algorithm alone.

Where your data is stored

Application and waitlist data is stored in a database operated by us, on infrastructure we control. It is not shared with third parties beyond the service providers named on this page (Mailgun for email delivery, and — only if you've consented to analytics — Google Analytics and the Meta Pixel).

International data transfers

Some of the service providers we use — including Mailgun, Sentry, Google Analytics, and Meta (the Facebook Pixel) — may process data on servers located outside your country, including in the United States. Where that happens, we rely on those providers' own safeguards for handling data responsibly across borders.

How long we keep it

We retain application data for as long as needed to run the current admissions cycle and to maintain a record of past scholars and applicants. We don't currently run an automated deletion schedule. If you'd like your data deleted sooner, contact us (below) and we'll act on it manually.

Your rights

Depending on where you live, you may have rights to access, correct, or request deletion of your personal data, and to object to or restrict certain processing. This applies whether or not your local law names these rights explicitly — write to us and we'll do our best regardless of jurisdiction. To exercise any of these, email hello@protechrise.com with your request; we'll respond directly.

Changes to this policy

If how we handle data changes materially, we'll update this page and change the "last updated" date above.

Contact

Questions about this policy or your data: hello@protechrise.com.
